items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I would always say hello to you and...with Jack Crystal and that guy that owned the place...I saw him the other day. Barnie...Bernie.

ctx.x: Yeah. But anyway, I though that you were from Boston, you know. And I say, 'well, he is a nice guy.' And I would always say hello to you and...with Jack Crystal and that guy that owned the place...I saw him the other day. Barnie...Bernie.
